sections.title: Places in town and location
body: Ask Finns det …? for existence and Var ligger …? for location.
Town words include bibliotek, apotek, bank, station, mataffär, torg.
K is often hard before a/o/u/å and soft before e/i/y/ä/ö; loans can differ.

examples.fi: Finns det ett apotek här nära?

examples.en: Yes, next to the grocery store.

sections.title: Det finns and prepositions
body: Use det finns + noun for existence: Det finns ett apotek här.
Use ligger for a place's location: Biblioteket ligger bredvid banken.
Learn prepositions in full phrases: framför stationen, bakom skolan, mellan husen.

examples.en: The pharmacy is next to the bank.
The bus stops in front of the station.
The park is behind the school.

assignment.title: Episode 9 mission: Places in town and location
assignment.instructions:
LISTEN: Hear the audio twice and answer: What is next to the pharmacy?

READ: Read once for purpose and once for detail. Answer: What is between the bank and café?

SPEAK: Ask for a library and describe its location. Try once without the model, then repeat more clearly.

WRITE: Write three map descriptions. Check word order and spelling.

TRANSFER: Move the place and replace bredvid.

RETURN: Use det finns and ligger once each.
assignment.model:
Speaking: Finns det ett bibliotek här? Ja, det ligger bredvid stationen.
Writing: Det finns en bank. Biblioteket ligger bredvid banken. Parken ligger bakom biblioteket.
